DIVYA YOGAM & THE INNER JOURNEY

Santoshi Shri. Arawindhan Ji

Spiritual Master • Mahaavadhani • Spiritual Guide to Inner Transformation

THE CENTRAL CREED

“Develop the human. Awaken the being.”

“What is the highest possibility within a human being?”

Conceived in 2000 alongside his educational journey, Divya Yogam was born from a fundamental inquiry: there comes a point in life when doing more is no longer the answer. Working with thousands of students, educators, and leaders revealed an imperative need beyond high performance—a need for inner stillness, clarity, and conscious living.

Verified Claim(CLM-028)
THE SEVEN STEPS

The Seven-Step Inner Journey

Each step moves the seeker deeper—from seeing oneself clearly to living with awareness every day.

01

Awareness

(See Within)

Recognise thoughts, emotions, and habitual mental patterns.

02

Acceptance

(Meet Yourself)

Embrace yourself completely without harsh self-judgement.

03

Alignment

(Come Into Balance)

Bring body, mind, intellect, and inner life into quiet harmony.

04

Stillness

(Be Present)

Move beyond constant repetitive thought and restlessness.

05

Experience

(Go Deeper)

Transform intellectual understanding into direct inner perception.

06

Oneness

(Feel Connected)

Dissolve artificial separation towards an interconnected universe.

07

Awakening

(Live Consciously)

Carry unshakeable inner awareness into family, work, and service.

FIVE PRINCIPLES

Five Principles • One Way of Living

Embracing the whole human being through awareness, stillness, and conscious action.

01

Awareness

See yourself clearly without illusion or reaction.

02

Stillness

Create space within amidst worldly noise.

03

Balance

Bring every dimension of life—body, mind, work—into harmony.

04

Oneness

Experience connection beyond the individual ego-self.

05

Conscious Living

Let awareness guide everyday choices, speech, and actions.

IN HIS WORDS

Eleven Thoughts at the Heart of His Teaching

Reflections that guide seekers toward inner balance and direct experience.

THOUGHT 01
“What is the highest possibility within a human being?”
Every learning and growth effort begins by asking what this person could yet become.
THOUGHT 02
“Develop the human. Awaken the being.”
Two movements held together: outer development of skills and character, with inner awakening of awareness.
THOUGHT 03
“Knowledge develops the mind. Experience develops wisdom. Awareness transforms life.”
Information changes what we know; lived experience changes how we see; awareness changes how we live.
THOUGHT 04
“Beyond achievement. Towards awareness.”
Achievement is not rejected; it is placed in a larger frame of how consciously we are living.
THOUGHT 05
“The journey is inward. The transformation is timeless.”
Outer change is shaped by circumstance; change that begins within becomes part of who we are.
THOUGHT 06
“The Divine is not far away. The journey to experience it begins within.”
The Divine is an experience discovered through stillness, closer than our own breath.

📍 Annual Convergence Held on December 21st in Puducherry

The annual flagship spiritual convergence gathering thousands of seekers, teachers, and families in Puducherry. Features mass Oneness Meditation, Seven Chakra pyramid energy activation, and discourses on conscious living by Santoshi Shri Arawindhan Ji.

NATURAL HEALTHInstitutional Record(CLM-030)

Avadhani: A Natural Healthy Lifestyle Program

A simple, natural daily discipline for students, teachers, parents, and families. Rooted in traditional Indian wellness practices: early rising before sunrise, oil pulling, Saptha Mahakriya, Kadukkai Podi (Terminalia chebula), and quiet morning meditation.

Five Life Stages:
Foundation (6–12) • Empowerment (13–19) • Excellence (20–35) • Harmony (36–55) • Grace (56+)
